paragraphs.notes: Bold section heading. The gap between 'B.' and the word is a tab stop in the original.

paragraphs.zh: Ein Stäubemittel wird erhalten, indem man 10 Gew.-Teile einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel (I) und 90 Gew.-Teile Talkum als Inertstoff mischt und in einer Schlagmühle zerkleinert.
paragraphs.en: A dusting agent is obtained by mixing 10 parts by weight of a compound of the general formula (I) and 90 parts by weight of talc as inert material and comminuting the mixture in a hammer mill.
paragraphs.notes: A small stray ink mark sits above the word 'Verbindung' on the first line of this paragraph; it is scanning dirt, not a character, and is not transcribed.

paragraphs.zh: Ein in Wasser leicht dispergierbares,benetzbares Pulver wird erhalten, indem man 25 Gewichtsteile einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel (I), 64 Gewichtsteile kaolinhaltigen Quarz als Inertstoff, 10 Gewichtsteile ligninsulfonsaures Kalium und 1 Gew.-Teil oleoylmethyltaurinsaures Natrium als Netz- und Dispergiermittel mischt und in einer Stiftmühle mahlt.
paragraphs.en: A readily water-dispersible, wettable powder is obtained by mixing 25 parts by weight of a compound of the general formula (I), 64 parts by weight of kaolin-containing quartz as inert material, 10 parts by weight of potassium ligninsulfonate and 1 part by weight of sodium oleoylmethyltaurate as wetting and dispersing agent, and grinding the mixture in a pinned-disc mill.
paragraphs.notes: The comma in 'dispergierbares,benetzbares' is printed with no following space; kept as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Ein in Wasser leicht dispergierbares Dispersionskonzentrat wird erhalten, indem man 20 Gewichtsteile einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel (I), 6 Gew.-Teile Alkylphenolpolyglykolether (®Triton X 207), 3 Gew.-Teile Isotridecanolpolyglykolether (8 EO) und 71 Gew.-Teile paraffinischem Mineralöl (Siedebereich z.B. ca. 255 bis über 277°C) mischt und in einer Reibkugelmühle auf eine Feinheit von unter 5 Mikron vermahlt.
paragraphs.en: A readily water-dispersible dispersion concentrate is obtained by mixing 20 parts by weight of a compound of the general formula (I), 6 parts by weight of alkylphenol polyglycol ether (®Triton X 207), 3 parts by weight of isotridecanol polyglycol ether (8 EO) and 71 parts by weight of paraffinic mineral oil (boiling range e.g. approx. 255 to above 277°C), and grinding the mixture in an attritor ball mill to a fineness of below 5 microns.
paragraphs.notes: The registered-trademark sign is printed before the name, as '®Triton X 207'. '8 EO' is printed with a space and denotes 8 ethylene oxide units. 'Reibkugelmühle' is translated literally as attritor ball mill.

paragraphs.zh: Ein emulgierbares Konzentrat wird erhalten aus 15 Gew.-Teilen einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel (I), 75 Gew.Teilen Cyclohexanon als Lösemittel und 10 Gew.-Teilen oxethyliertes Nonylphenol als Emulgator.
paragraphs.en: An emulsifiable concentrate is obtained from 15 parts by weight of a compound of the general formula (I), 75 parts by weight of cyclohexanone as solvent and 10 parts by weight of oxyethylated nonylphenol as emulsifier.
paragraphs.notes: '75 Gew.Teilen' is printed without the hyphen the other occurrences carry ('Gew.-Teilen'); kept as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Ein in Wasser dispergierbares Granulat wird erhalten, indem man 75 Gew.-Teile einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel(I), 10	"	ligninsulfonsaures Calcium, 5	"	Natriumlaurylsulfat, 3	"	Polyvinylalkohol und 7	"	Kaolin
paragraphs.en: A water-dispersible granule is obtained by 75 parts by weight of a compound of the general formula (I), 10	"	calcium ligninsulfonate, 5	"	sodium lauryl sulfate, 3	"	polyvinyl alcohol and 7	"	kaolin
paragraphs.notes: 'Formel(I)' is printed with no space before the bracket, unlike the other examples on this page. The ditto marks are printed as straight double-prime characters in a column and stand for 'Gew.-Teile'. The sentence is unfinished at the foot of the page: the list ends after 'Kaolin' with no punctuation and the clause continues on the next page.
